name: Zalaháshágy (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaháshágy (a red and blue shield with a tree, a lion, ears of grain and a sabre) between the name ZALAHÁSHÁGY above and the years 1898–1998 below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
